set.body:
Defect: Guarantee 2 -- no canonical value without its raw coordinate. Revision 1 made Raw a public case class, so Raw(fabricated, genuine.at, "x") is one line once any reader has emitted a coordinate.

Do: final class SourceCoordinate private[corpus] (artifact, container, row, column) -- non-case, so no Mirror, no fromProduct, no copy. final class Raw[+A] private[corpus] (value, at, literal). The sensitive thing is the JOINED value<->literal<->coordinate relation, not the coordinate alone.

Tests: equality, ordering, rendering. Forge probe in package storymodel4s.consumer -- OUTSIDE the private[corpus] tree, because a probe inside the package cannot tell a closed door from an open one. Positive control in the same file and scope; use typeCheckErrors, never a bare negative typeChecks, which returns false on ANY error and has already produced two false passes in this repo.

Mutants (SD1 — each must die, recorded by name): make SourceCoordinate a case class -> consumer probe must fail. Make Raw a case class -> same. Widen private[corpus] to public -> same.

Exit: The forge is demonstrated before it is closed (unforgeable-types.md: a fix without a demonstrated hole is a fix nobody can evaluate).

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S1 'Guarantee 2'
set.title: intake P1: SourceCoordinate and Raw as unforgeable carriers
